userStories.title: Build VPS connection wizard UI
userStories.description: As a user, I want a step-by-step wizard to enter my VPS connection details so I can connect my server.

Password: password input

userStories.title: Build VPS connection backend with SSH verification
userStories.description: As a system, I want to verify VPS access via SSH and check OS compatibility so the user knows their server is ready.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/servers/connect receives connection details
If store_credential is true, AES-256-GCM encrypt credential before storing
If store_credential is false, keep credential in memory only (do not persist)
SSH into server using node-ssh or ssh2 with provided credentials
Run `cat /etc/os-release` to detect OS and version
Validate OS is Ubuntu 22.04+ or Debian 12+
Return server info: host, os name, os version, architecture
On SSH failure: return 400 with error message ('invalid credentials' or 'host unreachable')
On OS mismatch: return 400 with 'Unsupported OS: [name]. Requires Ubuntu 22.04+ or Debian 12+'
Create server record with status 'connected' on success
Write audit log entry for connect attempt
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: ENCRYPTION_KEY env var used for AES-256. Ephemeral credentials stored in in-memory Map keyed by serverId:sessionId.

userStories.title: Build one-click install backend with SSE progress
userStories.description: As a system, I want to install Docker, Docker Compose, and Hermes on the VPS and stream progress via SSE so the user sees real-time results.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/servers/:id/install initiates the install workflow
Install steps executed sequentially via SSH: install Docker, install Docker Compose, create Hermes directory, generate docker-compose.yml, pull image, start containers
GET /api/servers/:id/install/events streams SSE events: { step, progress, message }
Each step emits progress event with percentage
On failure: emit { status: 'failed', error: 'message' } and stop
Install record created with status tracking
Retry: POST /api/servers/:id/install resets and starts from step 1
Credentials retrieved from DB (if stored) or from in-memory store
Write audit log on install start, success, and failure
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use Hono SSE helper. docker-compose.yml generated programmatically.

userStories.title: Build install progress UI
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see real-time install progress with a progress bar and live logs so I know what is happening.
acceptanceCriteria: After clicking 'Install', navigate to install progress page
Progress bar advances per step (25% increments)
Live log pane streams step messages with timestamps
On completion: green success banner with 'Go to Dashboard' button
On failure: red error banner with error message and 'Retry Install' button
Loading spinner during install
User can leave and return - install continues in background
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Uses EventSource to consume SSE from /api/servers/:id/install/events
